instruction: Please batch reduce the saturation of all images on the desktop to exactly 30 using automated GIMP processing, rather than adjusting them one by one.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not support reliable batch saturation adjustment to precise values in the OSWorld environment. Verifying exact saturation levels across multiple automatically processed images is not achievable with available tools.

llm_judge_reasons: The infeasible classification is correct - no metric exists to verify saturation reduction to exact values
Available GIMP metrics only support saturation INCREASE checking (check_saturation_increase_and_structure_sim), not decrease
Batch processing verification for multiple images with exact saturation values (30) is not supported by existing functions
The task requires verifying exact saturation=30 across 3 images (squirrel.jpeg, panda.jpeg, heron.jpeg), which cannot be achieved with available tools
The infeasible evaluator appropriately indicates this task cannot be reliably verified
